title: VIXEN CPU test depends on an unprovisioned external hull fixture
body: The full queued CPU CTest failed before its product assertion because /home/liory/codeman-cases/undertow/reports/cx-edmat5-evidence/pack-hullproof-final9-1280/recipes/hull.vxd was absent on the laptop; the witness had to copy the fixture from ws before the targeted test could pass. Suggested consolidation: package/provision the fixture or make the test use a lane-owned evidence root.
